name: Sun Tint Light SPF 40
tagline: A sheer tinted mineral sunscreen.
description: A tinted mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide and iron oxides in a single light-medium shade. Illustrative demo formula, not a tested retail sunscreen. The tint may not suit every skin tone.

usage.howTo: Shake and apply two finger-lengths evenly. Blend well at the jaw. Reapply every two hours outdoors.

ingredientsInci: Zinc Oxide, Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Glycerin, Iron Oxides, Titanium Dioxide, Cetearyl Alcohol, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Tocopherol, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Terra Tint Mineral SPF 50
tagline: A deeper-shade tinted mineral SPF.
description: A tinted mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide, iron oxides and niacinamide in a deeper, warmer shade. Illustrative demo formula, not a tested retail sunscreen. The tint may not suit every skin tone.

usage.howTo: Apply two finger-lengths evenly over the face and blend. Reapply every two hours outdoors.

ingredientsInci: Zinc Oxide, Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Iron Oxides, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Tocopherol, Phenoxyethanol.

name: Veil Tint Hybrid SPF 35
tagline: A light tinted hybrid sunscreen.
description: A tinted hybrid sunscreen with chemical UV filters and iron oxides in a sheer, adaptable shade. Illustrative demo formula, not a tested retail sunscreen. The tint may not suit every skin tone.

usage.howTo: Pump twice into your palm and spread over the face. Reapply every two hours outdoors.

ingredientsInci: Aqua, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Homosalate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Glycerin, Iron Oxides, Cetearyl Alcohol, Dimethicone, Phenoxyethanol.
